sentences.text: Red Bull India Private Limited & Anr vs State Of West Bengal &
Ors on 13 July, 2016
Author: Joymalya Bagchi Bench: Joymalya Bagchi

Red Bull India Private Limited & Anr.
 -vs-  State of West Bengal & Ors.

Mr. Anindya Mitra,
 Mr. Ayan Chakraborty,
 Mr. Abhixit Singh  ....... for the petitioners  Mr. Amitesh Banerjee,
 Mr. Tarak Karan  ........ for the State  Let affidavit-of-service filed by the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioners in Court today be kept on record.

Mr. Mitra, learned senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners, submits that there is substantial compliance of Regulation 2.2.2:10(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Packaging and labelling Regulations, 2011 inasmuch as the declaration "best before...........months and years" were expressed in numerals and such label was, in fact, approved by the concerned authority under Food Safety and Standards Act (FSS Act).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that Regulation 2.2.2:10(i) of the said Act  2 required the manufacturers to declare the 'month' and 'year' in "capital letters" thereby clearly indicating that it should be written in letters but not in numbers.
I am of the opinion that this issue requires to be decided upon exchange of affidavits.
Let affidavit-in-opposition be filed by the respondents within two weeks from date; reply thereto, if any, be filed within one week thereafter.
Let the matter appear under the heading "For Orders" three weeks hence.
Petitioners are directed to deposit a sum of Rs. 50,000/- with the learned Registrar General of this Court by 18.7.2016.

In the event such deposit is made there shall be a stay of operation of the impugned order dated 15th February, 2016 for a period of six weeks from date or until further order,
whichever is earlier.
Liberty is given to the petitioners to pray for extension of the interim order upon notice to the respondents.
The amount, so deposited, shall be kept in a short term fixed deposit account of a nationalised bank subject to the result of the litigation.

Liberty is also given to the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioners to amend the writ petition and implead the Director of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India as respondent no. 6 in the cause title portion of the writ petition.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Let copy of the amended writ petition be served upon the added respondent directly or through office of the learned Additional Solicitor General within a week and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.
The added respondent authority is also directed to file affidavit-in- opposition within the aforesaid time.

(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
